title: Uruk, one of the first great cities
summary: During the Uruk period the city grows to perhaps 50,000 residents by about 3100 BCE.
why: Arguably the first true city; writing and monumental buildings emerged here.

notes.problem: Title overclaims: source says 'one of the first cities' and 'arguably the first true city'; 'where writing first appears' is stronger than 'writing ... emerged here'.
